arabic text: HAEY LAILA KI TARAPTI KHAMOSHI ROTI RAHI
english translation text: Alas, Laila’s anguished silence continued to weep.

arabic text: ZAKHM BARCHI SAY NAHI HAY, DARDE SUGHRA SAY\nKAHO\nAHMADAY MURSAL KI MAQTAL MAY SHABHI ROTI RAHI
english translation text: The wound was not merely from the spear—it\ncarried Sughra’s pain. In the battlefield, the\nlikeness of Ahmad, the Messenger, lay weeping.

arabic text: AAEY GA MERA TO AKBAR, MUJHKO LAINAY KAY LIYE\nMUNTAZIR RAHOWN MAY SUGHRA HAY KHARI ROTI\nRAHI
english translation text: ‘My Akbar will come to take\nme with him.’ Sughra stood\nwaiting upon the road, weeping.

arabic text: JOSH KO HAI ZABT KAYSAY, KAAR LIYA ABBAS NAY\nTAYGHO KI CCHAOWN MAY ZARBAY HAIDERY ROTI\nRAHI.
english translation text: How did Abbas restrain the force\nof his courage? Beneath the shade\nof swords, Haider’s warrior spirit wept.

arabic text: BAYRIDA DARBAAR LAAYE, SAHIBAY TATHEER KO\nGAYSUWAY ZAINAB PAY ADIL BANDAGI ROTI RAHI.
english translation text: The Lady of Purity was brought unveiled into the\ncourt; before Zainab’s dishevelled hair, even worship itself wept.
